title: Patch: follow-up to #3464 from the after-merge spot-check
notes: The after-merge spot-check of #3464 (#3613). ART_DETAIL_SHORT_MAX, the cap on the detail floor's short list (R3331001), falls from 40 to 10, the list's length, and artRichness.test.ts now holds the list to exactly the cap: #3391 had left the list at 99 under a cap of 129, and #3464 took Classic's 89 off and wrote 40, 129 less 89. The shipped v0.5.13h note's cap, 157 to 68, should read 129 to 10. Under apps/web/src/cards/ (R2529000) only that test constant changes: how cards look and play is unchanged.
